description: MainActivity.java for an Android app, serving as the launcher activity that initializes the main UI components, manages menu options, and sets up logging features.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: A launcher activity that sets up the main fragment and logging for the app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the ElevationDragFragment if no instance state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and title based on current activity state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, toggling the log view display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging chain, from Android's LogWrapper to LogFragment.
